content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves an Acts 2:30 collision between the defender's and challenger's chains and states the result as neither chain forcing the other.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"neither chain forces the other","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"none","why":"The judge compared the competing chains as chains rather than demanding a single contrary-stating verse, so the text obeys K-C."}
